--help.stdout:
usage: hwpx [-h] [--version]
            {help,view,get,query,set,add,remove,move,copy,batch,dump,replay} ...

Semantic HWPX view/query/atomic-edit interface

positional arguments:
  {help,view,get,query,set,add,remove,move,copy,batch,dump,replay}
    help                catalog-generated interface help
    view                view a bounded semantic node
    get                 get a bounded semantic node
    query               run a bounded selector v1 query
    set                 apply one atomic set command
    add                 apply one atomic add command
    remove              apply one atomic remove command
    move                apply one atomic move command
    copy                apply one atomic copy command
    batch               apply JSON or JSONL command batches
    dump                dump, inspect, or safely repack a typed semantic
                        blueprint
    replay              atomically replay a validated blueprint request

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

unknown-command.stderr: {"error":{"code":"invalid_syntax","message":"argument command: invalid choice: 'unknown-command' (choose from help, view, get, query, set, add, remove, move, copy, batch, dump, replay)","recoverability":"terminal","schemaVersion":"hwpx.agent-error/v1","suggestion":"Run 'hwpx help' or 'hwpx <command> --help'.","target":"cli","validValues":[]},"ok":false}

usage: hwpx view [-h] [--depth DEPTH] [--child-limit CHILD_LIMIT]
                 [--expected-revision EXPECTED_REVISION]
                 [--format {json,jsonl,human}]
                 filename

positional arguments:
  filename

options:
